environment:
# Client ID of the PayPal sandbox app (Developer Dashboard > Apps & Credentials > Sandbox).
PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=

# Client secret of the same app. Server only.
PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET=

# PayPal REST API base URL. Sandbox only: no other host is allowed.
PAYPAL_API_BASE=

# ID of the webhook registered on the sandbox app for https://<host>/api/store/webhooks-router
# (Developer Dashboard > Apps & Credentials > the app > Webhooks). The hardened store sends it to
# verify-webhook-signature.
PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID=
